summary: Category 2 landfall near Destin, FL (105 mph); gusts to 117 mph; over 858,000 customers without power on 10 Oct; up to 12.97 in of rain at Bellwood, AL; at least two tornadoes in Georgia.

where: Coclé, Herrera, Los Santos, Veraguas, Chiriquí
summary: At least 27 minor injuries; more than 400 structures damaged (142 houses, 188 schools, 20 health facilities, 13 churches, 9 bridges); power out in six provinces; Tocumen airport flights suspended; Panama City water plant at about 20% capacity.

where: Baja California; Southern California coast (Long Beach Peninsula, Newport/Balboa)
summary: Baja: more than 100 people moved from the Tijuana River canal; Ensenada port closed; power out for over five hours in parts of Ensenada. Long Beach Peninsula: several days of high surf battered beachfront homes; 13 addresses red-tagged, 9 structures under a mandatory evacuation order (6400–6500 blocks of Seaside Walk) and 39 under an evacuation warning; city crews built sand berms that kept bay-side flooding out of Naples. Low-lying streets flooded along the coast. Rachel has weakened and moved into Nevada.
source: The Rio Times (Baja); KTLA 5 with Long Beach Fire Dept. Assistant Chief Jake Heflin (Long Beach)
footage_note: KTLA 5 report (11 Oct): consistent. Live shots from the Long Beach Peninsula, an on-camera Long Beach Fire official, City of Long Beach closure signs, KTLA aerials and licensed news footage of the damaged boardwalk homes. Separately, a "US Housing Report" YouTube compilation claiming the same flooding mixes in clips from other events (Northern California winter floods, a Florida hurricane) and should not be used; only its Balboa street clip with the white church tower matches KTLA footage.

summary: Category 4 near Manzanillo; classes suspended in 22 coastal municipalities of Jalisco and dozens evacuated; 10–20 in of rain forecast, locally 30 in; storm surge and mudslide warnings.

event: Flash flood from landslide-dam breach, Budhi Gandaki River (Nepal)
where: Gorkha district near Chumchure; evacuation down to Arughat
summary: A landslide dammed the river and the dam breached early on 11 Oct (flooding from about 04:00 local). About three dozen houses swept away; four bridges damaged or destroyed; Budhi Gandaki hydropower construction site and power and communication towers damaged. Army helicopters and ground troops rescued 49 people by Sunday afternoon. ICIMOD names the landslide-blockage failure as the probable cause.
source: AP (Binaj Gurubacharya), citing Nepal NDRRMA and the army; ICIMOD via The Annapurna Express
footage_note: NIK WEATHER video: clips fit the AP account (riverside buildings, bridges lost), but they come from many cameras; reverse image search found no older copy of the cover image; individual clips not yet traced.

where: Lipari town centre, Sottomonastero port, Canneto
summary: Overnight storm peaking about 01:00–01:40; the Ponte and Valle streams overflowed; dozens of homes flooded; cars trapped in the underpass at Sottomonastero port; mud on many roads including the town centre; debris washed onto the beach and into the sea; firefighters answered many calls, including rescues of drivers. Provisional tally.
footage_note: NIK WEATHER video: Lipari clips are consistent with the place and ANSA account (Aeolian dry-stone walls, Italian plates, mud in lanes and at the port, night then morning clean-up).
